facts.text: Kitchen_v0 is a gym.Env subclass described as a kitchen manipulation environment in MuJoCo
The environment imports dm_control, mujoco, gym and numpy
The robot has 9 degrees of freedom and the object state has 21
In the absvel control mode the action dimension is 9
The action space is gym.spaces.Box(-1.0, 1.0, shape=(action_dim,))
act_mid is zeros(action_dim) and act_amp is 2.0 * ones(action_dim)
The action is clipped to [-1, 1] and then mapped to act_mid + a * act_amp
The observation dict has the keys robot_qp, robot_qv, obj_qp and obj_qv
The observation arrays are cast to float32
The observation space is a Dict of Box spaces bounded by -inf and inf, shaped by the observation dict
step returns the observation dict, reward 0.0, done False and an empty info dict
reset restores the simulator and returns the observation; objects_done_set selects elements whose goal pose is restored
seed(seed) creates the environment's numpy random generator and returns [seed]
The MuJoCo model timestep is 0.002 s
kitchen-v0 is registered as a gym environment with max_episode_steps=280

determinism.notes: reset(seed) or cap.world.seed.v1 selects the Python random generator that draws the fake's placeholder initial jitter, so one seed and one action sequence repeat on the fake; upstream seeds numpy's generator (kitchen_v0.py:361-363), which feeds the observation noise rather than the reset pose, and this fake was not compared with it

gaps: the fake backend is not MuJoCo: it has no contacts, actuator dynamics, robot controller or observation noise, and its transition is a placeholder first-order motion of 9 robot positions plus a 9-vector of robot velocities; the 21 object positions and velocities stay at their placeholder values
the observation arrays have the upstream dimensions (robot_qp 9, robot_qv 9, obj_qp 21, obj_qv 21, kitchen_v0.py:63-64) but placeholder values; they were not compared with an upstream rollout
the 280-step TimeLimit of the registration (__init__.py:9) is modelled as truncation, although the bare Kitchen_v0.step never ends an episode (kitchen_v0.py:215-220)
no rendering, no worldgen wrapper and no object goal poses of reset(objects_done_set) are modelled
seed changes only the fake's placeholder initial jitter; the upstream seed feeds the observation-noise generator and its reset pose is deterministic
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state
no physical device is modelled and nothing was validated against hardware or against the upstream simulator

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
